get.description: Health probe: 200 when the database answers, 503 when it does not.
Seeded users for the role picker. No token: there is no real login (D-28).

schema.title: Response List Session Users Api V1 Session Users Get

post.description: Pick a seeded user. Send the token back as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (D-41).

get.description: Zones, nodes and links of one community in a single response (F1).

put.description:
Save the whole layout in one transaction (F1). Zones stay as seeded (D-64).

A self-link, an unknown node or zone, or a bad walking-time window answers 422; a duplicate
link (D-65) or node code answers 409. Nothing is saved unless the whole layout is valid.

get.description: The layout as a file, with codes instead of IDs (D-75).

post.description: Replace the layout with a file's; zones and nodes with the same code keep their IDs.
Add a camera or sensor to the supervisor's community.

patch.description: Change some of a node's fields; `status: offline` marks a blind spot (F9).

delete.description: Delete a node and every link that touches it.

post.description: Link two nodes of the supervisor's community with a walking-time window.

patch.description: Change a link's walking times, direction or distance.

get.description: Scripted scenarios with their live window; never their ground truth (D-70).

schema.title: Response Get Scenarios Api V1 Scenarios Get

post.description:
Play a scenario. The community's previous live run stops (D-77), and the guards take
the places the scenario's roster gives them (D-58). 409 when the scenario no longer fits
the layout or staff, with each problem in `details`.

get.description: The community's live run, or null when none has been started (or it was replaced).

schema.title: Response Current Run Api V1 Scenario Runs Current Get

post.description: Play a ready or paused run; on a playing run, only change its speed.
Stop playback and clear the run's events and derived rows; it can play again.

Store a batch of one run's events in the one contract (D-16, D-30), link them into
tracks (F3), check the rules on each track (F4) and push it all on the run's stream.

422 for a malformed event, an unknown field, a node outside the community, mixed runs, or
an event earlier than the run's latest; 409 once the run has finished or been replaced.

schema.title: Response Post Events Api V1 Events Post

get.description: Events in time order, filtered by run, node and time (`from` inclusive, `to` not).

schema.title: Response Get Events Api V1 Events Get

get.description: Anonymous paths (F3) in order of their first sighting, each with its ordered segments.

schema.title: Response Get Tracks Api V1 Tracks Get

get.description: One path with its ordered segments; 404 once it has expired and been purged (D-11).

The community's three anomaly rules (F4), each with its thresholds and the rule-based
severity of its alerts (D-60).

schema.title: Response Get Rules Api V1 Rules Get

put.description:
Change a rule's thresholds, or switch it on or off; the next batch of events runs on them
with no code change (F4). Fields left out stay as they are. 422 when the thresholds are not
valid, with each problem in `details`.

schema.title: Response Put Rule Api V1 Rules  Key  Put

get.description:
Alerts (F4–F6) in the order they were raised, each with its rule, severity, guard, next
camera and evidence.

schema.title: Response Get Alerts Api V1 Alerts Get

post.description:
Confirm or dismiss an alert with an optional one-line reason (F6). The action is stamped
with the run's clock, so the incident timeline can place it (D-62), and every open screen
gets the change as `alert_update`. 409 when the alert has been handled already.

AfterHoursParams.title: AfterHoursParams
AfterHoursParams.description:
An appearance in a zone of one of `zone_kinds` from `start` to `end` in the community's
time zone; the period may span midnight (D-54).

AlertActionIn.title: AlertActionIn
AlertActionIn.description: Confirm or dismiss, with an optional one-line reason (F6).

AlertOut.title: AlertOut
AlertOut.description:
One alert: a rule matching one anonymous path (D-18), the guard it went to and the
camera to check next (F5). Keep the copy with the highest `version`: the stream may deliver
an older one after a newer one.

EventBatch.title: EventBatch
EventBatch.description: Events of one run in time order; a batch is stored whole or not at all.

EventIn.title: EventIn
EventIn.description: One sighting. `local_track_id` is the camera's own anonymous ID for the object.

LayoutFile.title: LayoutFile
LayoutFile.description: A community layout as a file. References are codes, never database IDs (D-75).

LayoutIn.title: LayoutIn
LayoutIn.description: The whole editable layout, saved in one transaction (PUT /communities/{id}/layout).

LinkPatch.title: LinkPatch
LinkPatch.description: Only the fields sent change. The ends of a link are fixed: delete it and add another.

LoiterParams.title: LoiterParams
LoiterParams.description: At least `threshold_s` in one zone within the last `window_s` (D-52).

NextNodeBasis.title: NextNodeBasis
NextNodeBasis.description:
Why this camera comes next (D-20, D-57): the walk and distance from the alert's node, the
share of normal routes that take this step, and how well it keeps the direction of travel.

NodeIn.title: NodeIn
NodeIn.description: A node in a saved layout. A new node's ID comes from the client, so links can name it.

NodePatch.title: NodePatch
NodePatch.description: Only the fields sent change; `zone_id: null` clears the zone.

NormalRoute.title: NormalRoute
NormalRoute.description: A route residents normally take, as node codes in walking order (D-53).

OffRouteParams.title: OffRouteParams
OffRouteParams.description: A step between two nodes that no normal route takes (D-53).

RuleUpdate.title: RuleUpdate
RuleUpdate.description: What to change; leave out what stays. Each field in `params` replaces the stored one.

RunCreate.title: RunCreate
RunCreate.description: Start a live run; it stops the community's previous one (D-77).

SegmentOut.title: SegmentOut
SegmentOut.description: A track's stay in front of one node, with the events it is built from.

TrackOut.title: TrackOut
TrackOut.description:
One anonymous cross-camera path (F3), its segments in order. `status` is `expired` only
in the stream message that removes it: an expired track is deleted (D-11, D-56).
